DripRuntimePlan.title: DripRuntimePlan
DripRuntimePlan.description:
How long to run a drip block, and what governed that duration.

Present only when the request supplied emitter geometry or a measured block flow.
Runtime is derived from the reported depth and rate, so the three always describe
the same event.
